title: How to upgrade or downgrade your plan
content:
## Upgrading your plan

### Steps
1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Change Plan**.
2. Select the new plan.
3. Review the prorated charge summary.
4. Click **Confirm Upgrade**.

### Proration
- Upgrades take effect **immediately**.
- You are charged a prorated amount for the remainder of the current billing period.
- Example: Upgrading from Pro ($99) to Enterprise ($299) on day 15 of a 30-day cycle → you are charged $100 (half the difference) immediately.

## Downgrading your plan

### Steps
1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Change Plan**.
2. Select the lower plan.
3. Review what features you will lose.
4. Click **Confirm Downgrade**.

### What happens on downgrade
- Downgrade takes effect at the **end of the current billing period**.
- You keep current plan features until then.
- Resources exceeding the new plan limits (e.g., more than 3 team members on Starter) will be read-only until you reduce them.
- Excess dashboards and alerts are not deleted — they are archived and restored if you upgrade again.

## Cancellation vs downgrade
- Downgrading to Starter is not the same as cancelling. To cancel, see KB-012.

## Failed upgrades
If an upgrade fails due to a payment issue, your current plan remains active. Fix your payment method in **Settings → Billing → Payment Methods** and retry.
